label: STOPP D22
title: Levodopa or a dopamine agonist for essential tremor
statement: Levodopa or dopamine agonists for benign essential tremor (no evidence of efficacy)

plain_summary: Levodopa and dopamine agonist medicines do not help essential tremor, so they add side effects for no benefit.

medicine_groups.name: Levodopa medicines
medicine_groups.note: Each brand is levodopa combined with the named medicine. Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too.

medicine_groups.name: Dopamine agonists
medicine_groups.note: Tablets, patches and injections count. Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too.

needs_facts.what: Use of this levodopa medicine or dopamine agonist for essential tremor
needs_facts.meets: The record identifies essential tremor as a reason for this levodopa or dopamine agonist.

options.words: Essential tremor is a reason for this medicine
This medicine is used only for another reason

rule_for_models: Apply only to people aged 65 years or older. Below 65 there is no finding. If age is unknown, record eligibility as unresolved and confirm age before reporting either finding. Report a finding if the record identifies essential tremor as a reason for a Group A levodopa medicine or a Group B dopamine agonist. If the indication is unclear, including when both essential tremor and Parkinson disease are recorded without a treatment link, report a possible finding and name the missing fact "Use of this levodopa medicine or dopamine agonist for essential tremor". Exclude use solely for another recorded indication. Cite a Group A or B supply and, for a confirmed finding, the line linking that medicine to essential tremor.
cannot_be_seen: Why the medicine was started (Parkinson disease is the usual reason; ropinirole and pramipexole are also used for restless legs) and the cause of any tremor.
ask_the_gp: Whether the medicine is helping, and whether the tremor has been checked as essential tremor or as Parkinson disease.
